inputs.model_selection_basis: Sole E2 candidate clearing preregistered Gate B (3-fold unbiased variogram 92.90 = -6.40% <= 94.28, primary scaled CRPS 1.1507 = -0.86%, 90% coverage 89.4%/89.6%/88.8%)
inputs.causal_origin_eligibility: All hourly origins with history >= 168h and current-bucket usable == True and positive high/low volumes (never conditioned on future complete_24h target survival)

reused_machinery.hourly_price_conversion_for_integer_lots: avg_high_price_gp = max(1, round(avg_high_price)), avg_low_price_gp = max(1, round(avg_low_price)) for non-null positive prices; null/zero-volume preserved as NA

expected_net_edge_formula.expected_net_return: mean over tau in {0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90} of costs.net_return(estimated_buy_gp, estimated_sell_gp_at_tau, DEFAULT_TAX)

entry_conditions: usable_t == True, not inverted_spread, high_price_volume > 0, low_price_volume > 0, present(buy_limit)
cross-horizon trajectory gate: q50_h24 >= 0.0 when H=4; q50_h4 >= -0.01 when H=24
policy_specification.exit_rule: backtest.simulate causal hold timer: sell order submitted at first_fill + H * 3600 seconds (H in {4, 24}), executed across post-latency buckets subject to participation_bps volume cap

position_sizing_and_capital.four_hour_buy_limit_enforcement: backtest.simulate per-item 14400s window starting at first buy fill, capped at items.parquet buy_limit (73 known, 1 unknown forbidden)

training_only_tuning_grid.tuning_window_per_fold: Contiguous 21-day (504h) pre-validation inner window [val_start - 21*86400, val_start) strictly inside each fold training period, held out of gradient updates by split_inner_train_val
training_only_tuning_grid.selection_criterion: Maximize inner-training net_gp on primary_execution_assumptions (tie-breaker: lower turnover, then larger holding_hours, then larger min_net_edge_bps)
training_only_tuning_grid.anti_overfit_reporting_rule: Every single cell of the 6-cell grid MUST be evaluated and reported on outer validation folds (1, 2, 3 and pooled 270d) regardless of whether it wins or loses; zero post-hoc threshold edits permitted

null_controls.description: Circular/block time-permutation (5 deterministic shifts/replicates, block=168h) of predicted quantile vectors within each (fold, item) before computing expected_net_edge against true current ask_t/bid_t; preserves marginal signal distribution while destroying conditional timing
Inverts predicted return direction (q_tau_h -> -q_{1-tau, h}) at every origin while preserving exact dispersion and current ask_t/bid_t
Subtracts predicted median drift at every horizon (q_tau_h -> q_tau_h - q50_h), isolating pure dispersion/skew against the cost wall
